description: Data for: Risk Assessment of Integrated Electrical, Natural Gas and District Heating Systems Considering Solar Thermal CHP Plants and Electric Boilers is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Juan Yu. The file "Data_IEEE9_NGS6_DHS7" includes the connection figure and network parameters of case 1, and case 1 is composed of IEEE 9-node system, NGS 6-node system and 7-node district heating system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
